_notes: EN changed 'Hangyul Univ team' to 'Hangyul team': cur 'Hangyul Univ ekibi' → 'Hangyul ekibi' wherever EN says Hangyul team (kept where EN still says Hangyul Univ team).
EN replaced em-dash pairs with separate sentences; Turkish success/writing/concierge strings follow.
plan = plan (paket → plan); essay = yazı; standard admission letter = standart kabul mektubu; 'Preparing your visa' → visa document wording.
Kept 'niyet mektubu' for personal statement: it is the bundle-wide tr term (~20 strings); switching needs an owner decision.
EN still mixes 'your counselor' and 'the Hangyul team' in visaroute/concierge/success; tr mirrors EN (danışmanınız / Hangyul ekibi).
Kept 'Program' (visaroute:form.field.program) identical to EN: it is the correct Turkish word.
